Third-party libraries, kept on this site so no tool has to wait on another server. All are MIT-licensed except where noted.
  three.r128.min.js, OrbitControls.r128.js, BufferGeometryUtils.r128.js   three.js r128 (https://threejs.org), for the micrometers and the telescopic gauge
  three/                                                                   three.js 0.170.0 as ES modules (+ addons), for the calipers and the height gage
  clipper.js                                                               Clipper 6.4.2 (Boost licence), for the depth micrometer
Fonts and icons are in fonts/ and js/icons.js (Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 icons, CC BY 4.0).
